sar.narrative: This Suspicious Activity Report details coordinated card-not-present fraud affecting customer account C07212 and card C07212-K2, involving online activity through a compromised device. On November 9, 2016 at 02:28:40 UTC, an unauthorized online transaction (ID 3442995) for $150.04 in product category H was processed under billing region 325. The transaction was conducted using device D007351 (Samsung SM-J327T1 Build/NRD90M, Android 7.0, Chrome 65.0, 1280x720), which was newly introduced to this account. Knowledge graph analysis identified device D007351 as a core link in fraud ring 34603052 with a 48.43-fold lift over baseline fraud rates. Device D007351 was previously confirmed as fraudulent in closed cases CC-5527 on card C10979-K1 and CC-5533 on card C07247-K1. Within the same 48-hour monitoring window, device D007351 executed near-identical authorizations across multiple accounts, including transaction 3440243 ($150.06) on card C01629-K1 and transaction 3442910 ($150.09) on card C11309-K1. The flagged transaction generated a model score of 0.90, reflecting an empirical historical fraud rate of 92.1%. Furthermore, this online activity departed significantly from the legitimate cardholder's baseline, which consisted exclusively of card-present transactions in product category W. Direct unauthorized exposure on card C07212-K2 totals $150.04. The bank has blocked card C07212-K2, flagged connected cards C01629-K1 and C11309-K1 for monitoring, and filed this report due to suspected organized ring fraud.
